title: List sort panel: a number field's direction reads 「A → Z / Z → A」 instead of 「小 → 大 / 大 → 小」
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

Found by the milestone acceptance of #35547 (record #37020) on main `305fe60e`, zh-CN console.

**Reproduction:**
1. On `showcase_task`, click `[data-testid=condition-sort]`, then `[data-testid=sort-panel-fields-item-estimate_hours]`, then Escape.
2. Click `condition-sort` again, then `[data-testid=sort-builder-direction]`, and read the options.

**Expected:** 「小 → 大」 and 「大 → 小」. **Actual:** 「A → Z」 and 「Z → A」. The same happens for `progress`. A date field (`due_date`) correctly shows 「最早 → 最新」.

`sortDirectionLabel` has a size-wording path that the live sort builder does not reach for number fields.

QA-source: #37020 · records-forms.list-header-menu-and-sort-levels · observed beside the clauses
